verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents its core NIW service as drafting the petition, legal brief, and tailored recommendation letters, then filing the I-140 with USCIS. A dedicated attorney handles the case from start to finish, and RFE responses are included. The evidence-binder assembly and the expert-versus-support letter split are not explicitly documented, so coverage is not complete. missing for 10: explicit evidence-binder/exhibit compilation, distinct expert vs. support letter preparation, explicit forms preparation beyond the I-140 filing mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: We draft your petition, legal brief, and recommendation letters, then file your I-140 with USCIS.
We learn your accomplishments and craft a case and recommendation letters written for your specific story.
You work directly with a dedicated attorney from start to finish.
We respond to any requests for evidence at no additional cost.
